verdict.rationale: Xero documents its own machine-to-machine credential type, Custom Connections, which is limited to a single organisation, and its API uses an OAuth 2.0 security schema. That is a thin form of scoped credential an agent could use, but nothing shows granular permission scopes or least-privilege controls. missing for 10: documented granular OAuth scopes or permission selection, read-only or least-privilege credential options, agent-specific credential guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
